sentences.chinese: 我今天早上五点起床了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang wǔ diǎn qǐchuáng le.
sentences.english_hint: I got up at five this morning.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone when you got up today.
sentences.source_note: 00:21 correction removes 在 before the time expression.

sentences.chinese: 我会游泳，但是不会冲浪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì yóuyǒng, dànshì bú huì chōnglàng.
sentences.english_hint: I can swim, but I can't surf.
sentences.scenario: Explain your skills at the beach.
sentences.source_note: 02:17 correction and Drill 1 use 会 for learned skills.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi zuò guo fānchuán.
sentences.english_hint: I haven't been on a sailboat yet.
sentences.scenario: Answer a question about sailing experience.
sentences.source_note: 04:46 correction adds 过 to express lack of experience.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài hòupái huì yùnchē.
sentences.english_hint: I get carsick in the back seat.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you need a different seat.
sentences.source_note: Vocabulary model addresses the learner's recurring difficulty describing carsickness in the back seat.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qìwèi ràng wǒ yùnchē.
sentences.scenario: Explain your reaction to a smell in the car.
sentences.source_note: 09:36 correction supplies a complete cause-and-result sentence and the correct word for carsickness.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huábīng de shíhou, tuǐ hěn téng.
sentences.english_hint: My legs hurt when I ice skate.
sentences.source_note: 19:01 correction replaces 疼很多 with 很疼 and puts the situation first.
38:13 correction moves the companion before the main verb.

sentences.chinese: 我下个月要去欧洲旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu.
sentences.english_hint: I'm going to Europe next month.
sentences.scenario: Describe the travel plan discussed in class.
sentences.source_note: 40:00 correction addresses both next-month wording and destination word order.

sentences.scenario: Tell your teacher you have questions.
sentences.source_note: 54:34 correction supplies 有 in a complete sentence.

sentences.scenario: Ask someone to repeat an unclear question.
sentences.source_note: 58:42 correction; requests for repetition also recur around 46:03.

sentences.scenario: Tell someone where your father lives.
sentences.source_note: 01:00:33 correction fixes repeated placement of 住在 after family members' locations.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng qù Zhōngguó le.
sentences.english_hint: I've wanted to visit China for a long time.
sentences.scenario: Describe your longstanding wish to visit China.
sentences.source_note: Drill 6 models this longstanding-wish pattern; China travel is a major personal topic.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Zhōngguó.
sentences.english_hint: I haven't been to China yet.
sentences.scenario: Explain that your planned China trip will be your first.
sentences.source_note: Drill 3 and the final routine correct the learner's wording for not having visited China.

sentences.chinese: 旅游的时候，我喜欢自由行。
sentences.pinyin: Lǚyóu de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan zìyóuxíng.
sentences.english_hint: When traveling, I prefer independent travel.
sentences.scenario: Explain your preferred way to travel.
sentences.source_note: Drill 4 practices this situation-first structure; the learner expresses this preference at 01:18:44.
